name: BlockVectra
tagline: Multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC and indexed data for developers and AI agents
description: A remote MCP server for BlockVectra's multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC and indexed Data API, for developers and AI agents. This catalog command configures keyless access to documentation, chain discovery, pricing and status, plus RPC methods permitted by each chain's public policy. It does not configure an API key or authenticated request headers. Data API, account tools and keyed RPC require the user's own API key configured separately as a private `x-api-key` HTTP header; see the repository setup guide.
